promoted.reason: The candidate semantics were regenerated independently by both pinned current upstream encoders and reciprocally accepted by the opposite decoder. Historical bytes were not copied.

rejected.reason: Historical Kompress output is not neutral upstream evidence and decoding loses the foreign compressed representation needed for signed relays.
The historical message-three size constant conflicts with its 64-byte transcript; no pinned dual-upstream deterministic KAT was established in Phase 1.
Signed Long versus UInt64 hash-to-range behavior remains unresolved and could silently define incompatible membership semantics.
